provenance: measured (local CPU run of the NeMo Guardrails library)

warmup.text: Hello, what are the opening hours of your nearest store?

latency_definition: wall-clock ms of the library call(s) for one record, models already loaded

nemo_heuristics.combination: flagged = any([lp_check['jailbreak'], ps_ppl_check['jailbreak']]) (same as actions.jailbreak_detection_heuristics in-process path)

rule_notes.prefix_suffix_perplexity: only evaluated when text has >= 20 whitespace words; flag if perplexity of first 19 words or of words[-20:-1] >= threshold

model.revision_note: library calls from_pretrained without a pinned revision; this is the cached snapshot commit that was resolved

score_fields.perplexity: full-text perplexity computed by the library (captured, not recomputed)
score_fields.length_per_perplexity: len(text) / perplexity (derived from the captured value)
score_fields.ps_evaluated: False when text has < 20 words (library returns not-jailbreak)
score_fields.prefix_perplexity / suffix_perplexity: captured from the library call when evaluated

thresholds.decision: classifier label from the ONNX random forest (argmax of class probabilities); the library exposes no configurable threshold

classifier.licence: NVIDIA Open Model License (model card); repo not gated

embedding_model.revision_note: library calls from_pretrained(trust_remote_code=True) without a pinned revision; this is the cached snapshot commit that was resolved

compat_shims: During initialize_model() only, AutoModel.from_pretrained(use_safetensors=True) also receives safe_serialization=True. Without it NeMo 0.24.1's own in-process path fails with 'OSError: Model name Snowflake/snowflake-arctic-embed-m-long was not found.' because the remote NomicBert loader ignores use_safetensors and the repo has no pytorch_model.bin.
transformers pinned to 4.x: under transformers 5.19.0 the remote NomicBert forward raises AttributeError: 'NomicBertModel' object has no attribute 'get_extended_attention_mask'.

score_fields.score: library value: +P(jailbreak) when flagged, -P(benign) when not flagged
score_fields.p_jailbreak: derived: score if flagged else 1 + score (binary RF probabilities sum to 1)

thresholds.decision: flag if any YARA rule matches (no numeric threshold)

notes: Library default config has injections=[] (checks nothing); all four built-in rule sets were enabled here.

Rail is designed as an output rail ($bot_message) targeting code (Python os/subprocess/networking imports), SQL injection, Jinja template injection and Markdown XSS. It does not target natural-language prompt injection; here it is applied to the input text.
The library action recompiles the YARA rules on every call; latency includes that.

other_rails_not_included.jailbreak_detection NIM path (nim_base_u: Same NemoGuard JailbreakDetect model served by an NVIDIA NIM; not needed because the model runs in-process here.
other_rails_not_included.context_bloat_detection: Non-LLM, local; targets padded/oversized/repetitive context-manipulation (token-budget exhaustion), not prompt-injection semantics. Not included.
other_rails_not_included.regex: Non-LLM, local, but ships no default patterns (user-supplied regexes only). Not included.
other_rails_not_included.hf_classifier: Generic local HF text-classification rail with no default model; using it means picking a third-party classifier, not a NeMo detector. Not included.
other_rails_not_included.guardrails_ai detect_jailbreak: Wrapper around a third-party Guardrails AI hub validator (hub://guardrails/detect_jailbreak); requires the separate guardrails-ai package and hub install. Not included.
other_rails_not_included.activefence / prompt_security / pangea /: Rails that call hosted third-party services (API key / external endpoint); not run to keep spend at zero and because they are not NeMo's own detectors.
